info.description:
## Digital Finance Tracker API Collection

- Use `{{baseUrl}}` for server URL (e.g., http://localhost:8000)
- Use `{{bearerToken}}` variable for Auth0 JWT when calling protected endpoints.

**Key Flows**:
- Test connection with `/api/test` and `/health`
- Use `/api/auth/*` endpoints for login/auth flows
- Use `/api/users/*` for user profile/settings
- Use `/api/transactions/*` for transaction data

More info: Contact support@digitalfinance.com

Welcome to the Digital Finance Tracker API Postman Collection!

**Setup:**

- Set the `baseUrl` variable to your local/staging/prod server.
    
- For protected endpoints, set the `bearerToken` variable (copy your Auth0 JWT here).
    

**Key flows:**

- Start with Auth endpoints to get a valid token.
    
- Test API health and connectivity with `/health` and `/api/test`.
    
- All error/success response formats follow a strict API contract (see descriptions).
    

Contact the backend team with questions or for credentials.

Full instructions available in the README.md within this folder.
